name: Act (TDD Cycle)
description: Work through todo.md items using the RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycle on a new branch. Use to implement checklist items test-first.
description_zh: 按红-绿-重构循环，依据 todo.md 中的待办项逐项实现。
prompt:
Follow the RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycle for the items in todo.md:
1. Open todo.md and select the first unchecked items to work on.
2. Plan each item carefully, then share your plan.
3. Create a new branch and implement the plan test-first: write a failing test (RED), make it pass (GREEN), then refactor.
4. Check off the finished items in todo.md.
5. Commit your changes.
